headline: Ransomware Hits Denso and Lumax, Causing Major Disruptions
body: A ransomware attack has severely impacted the operations of Denso Corporation, leading to a complete halt of production at several important facilities. The cyber assault specifically targeted their systems controlling manufacturing processes. This has led to significant operational disruption as technical teams strive for resolution. Lumax Industries Ltd. also reported problems within its supply chain activities linked to this cyber event. Both organizations are actively working with cybersecurity experts to restore normal operations, though no specific recovery timeline has been provided yet.
